task_description: Implement the complete DCDSS .NET 8 Web API backend from the approved revision-2 design. Covers all 8 entity/EF layers, 7 enum types, 8 Fluent API configurations, 16 repository interfaces + implementations, 17 service interfaces + implementations, 9 controllers, audit filter, global exception middleware, JWT auth, admin seeder, CDS engine with seed rules, reference-range parser, and full Program.cs DI wiring.
